requirements.quote: Provide an actively maintained Linux LTS BSP with bootloader, drivers and reproducible offline build instructions. Support supplier-delivered code for five years from MP release.
requirements.text: Provide a Linux LTS BSP with bootloader, drivers, and offline build instructions, supported for five years.

requirements.quote: Support Modbus RTU/TCP and MQTT 3.1.1 over TLS 1.2 or 1.3 through the buyer device agent. Expose documented interfaces for network settings, time sync, I/O and health.
requirements.text: Support Modbus RTU/TCP and MQTT 3.1.1 over TLS 1.2/1.3 and provide documented interfaces.

requirements.quote: Verify every executable boot stage and update image; reject unsigned, modified or rollback-blocked images. Permit only buyer-authorised signed recovery images.
requirements.text: Verify boot stages and update images, rejecting unauthorized or modified ones.

requirements.quote: Provision a per-unit key and X.509 identity using a buyer-approved PKI workflow. Private keys shall not appear in logs, exports or general factory storage. No shared default passwords.
requirements.text: Provision per-unit keys and X.509 identities using buyer-approved PKI workflow, ensuring private key security.

requirements.quote: Provide SPDX or CycloneDX software bill of materials for each release, including dependencies and licences. Resolve exploitable critical/high findings before MP; exceptions require written risk acceptance.
requirements.text: Provide software bill of materials for each release and resolve critical vulnerabilities before MP.

requirements.quote: Lock debug interfaces in production. Restrict services to an approved allowlist; log security events; protect credentials and configuration at rest.
requirements.text: Secure debug interfaces, restrict services, log security events, and protect sensitive data.

requirements.quote: Notify buyer within 24 h of a confirmed security incident or exploitable critical flaw. Supply mitigation within 72 h and verified patch within 30 days unless buyer approves another plan.
requirements.text: Notify buyer of security incidents within 24 hours and provide mitigation within 72 hours.

requirements.quote: Demonstrate 1,000 16-bit Modbus registers per second: 800 over Ethernet and 100 over each RS-485 link at 115.2 kbit/s using block reads. Publish an aggregate 10 kB MQTT payload every second over TLS, while logging local health once per second. Use a 100 Mbit/s test LAN with round-trip latency below 5 ms.
requirements.text: Demonstrate specific Modbus and MQTT performance metrics under defined conditions.

requirements.quote: Over an eight-hour run, gateway-added time from completed poll to publish shall be <=250 ms at the 99th percentile, with no lost acquired records, CPU utilisation averaging <=70% and no unbounded memory growth.
requirements.text: Ensure performance metrics are met during an eight-hour run.

requirements.quote: Buffer at least 24 hours of this telemetry during network loss and forward it in order after reconnection without blocking fresh collection.
requirements.text: Buffer 24 hours of telemetry during network loss and forward it after reconnection.

requirements.quote: Buyer shall supply the device-agent interface at G0 and a frozen test build by week 6. Supplier shall provide a simulator until then and price integration in NRE.
requirements.text: Provide a simulator until week 6 and include integration in NRE.

requirements.quote: The buyer retains the device agent; the supplier owns defects in its BSP, drivers and provisioning tools. Joint defects require a shared root-cause review within five business days.
requirements.text: Supplier owns defects in BSP and tools; joint defects require review within five days.
